checks.name: SSR: prerendered HTML contains the app content
SSR: hydration annotations are present
SSR: content is not hidden by inline styles before hydration
SSR: server-only branch is not rendered (panel closed, spinner unmounted)
Hydration: app hydrates (afterNextRender marks the client)
Presence: enter plays a real animation and ends fully visible
Presence: leave keeps the node mounted, then removes it
Interaction: moveWhileHover scales the card (real pointer hover)
Reactive state: [moveAnimation] follows a signal change
Keyed list: added row enters; removed row leaves after its animation
Teardown: destroying a looping + hover host leaves no running animations
No console errors or page errors during the whole session
Reduced motion: panel appears with no running animations
Reduced motion: state change applies immediately
No JS: server HTML is readable and visible
Slow hydration: SSR content is visible before the bundle arrives
Slow hydration: a pre-hydration click is replayed once the app is ready
Measured: narrow-import production bundle (main.js, includes Angular + router + hydration)
